scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:protocol && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:engine: npm --prefix packages/engine install && npm --prefix packages/engine run build
scripts.build:figma: npm --prefix packages/figma-reader install && npm --prefix packages/figma-reader run build
scripts.build:server: npm --prefix apps/server install && npm --prefix apps/server run build
scripts.build:extension: npm --prefix apps/vscode-extension install && npm --prefix apps/vscode-extension run build
scripts.build:dashboard: npm --prefix apps/web-dashboard install && npm --prefix apps/web-dashboard run build
scripts.build:apps: npm run build:figma && npm run build:server && npm run build:mcp && npm run build:extension && npm run build:dashboard
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm --prefix packages/protocol test && npm --prefix packages/engine test && npm --prefix packages/figma-reader test && node --test apps/server/tests/*.test.mjs && node --test apps/vscode-extension/tests/*.test.cjs && npm --prefix apps/web-dashboard test && npm --prefix apps/mcp-server test
scripts.test:figma: npm run build:figma && npm --prefix packages/figma-reader test
scripts.build:protocol: npm --prefix packages/protocol install && npm --prefix packages/protocol run build
scripts.build:mcp: npm --prefix apps/mcp-server install && npm --prefix apps/mcp-server run build
